row.team_price_text: Pro: $20/mo platform fee incl. 1 deploying seat; extra Owner/Member seats $20/mo each (billed monthly)
row.evidence: Vercel's pricing page lists "SCIM & Directory Sync" under Enterprise only, and the Directory Sync docs say it "is only available for Enterprise Teams".
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated) but the shape changed since June: the $150/mo Directory Sync add-on for Pro is gone. The pricing page now shows Directory Sync (SCIM) as Enterprise only (Pro column '—'), the Pro add-on list in the Pro plan docs names SAML SSO ($300/mo) but no Directory Sync, and the SAML docs say Directory Sync is available on Enterprise plans. SAML SSO alone is a $300/mo Pro add-on with JIT team join; removals are manual without Directory Sync. Pro is billed monthly ($20/mo platform fee with 1 deploying seat, extra deploying seats $20/mo, viewer seats free). No public SCIM base URL, schema or attribute docs: Directory Sync is configured through an in-dashboard wizard.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: Free plan for non-commercial personal projects; cannot add paid team seats.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $20/mo platform fee (1 deploying seat included); additional deploying seats $20/month each; viewer seats free
plans.notes: SAML SSO is a $300/month paid add-on on Pro. Directory Sync (SCIM) is not offered on Pro.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit logs are exported as CSV from the dashboard; Custom SIEM Log Streaming (being replaced by Audit Log Drains) is a paid Enterprise extra.

operations.notes: Create/update/deactivate/group push from the Okta OIN capability list; Vercel's own docs describe add (invite) and removal from the team.

deprovision.notes: A user removed in the directory is removed from the Vercel team. With Enterprise Managed Users, a managed account removed from all of the organisation's teams is eventually deleted.

roles.how: Directory group to Vercel team role (or access group) mapping; reserved group names such as vercel-role-owner and vercel-role-member assign roles; role mappings also settable via POST /v1/teams/{teamId}/dsync-roles

limitations.text: Directory Sync overwrites existing team roles, including those of the owner performing the sync, so owners can lock themselves out.
No public SCIM endpoint, schema, attribute or rate-limit documentation; setup is a guided dashboard dialog.

auth.notes: Access tokens are scoped to the full account, a team, or a single project.

capabilities.notes: delete_user means removing a member from the team, not deleting the Vercel account. Groups are Access Groups.

endpoints.purpose: List team members (paginated; filter by role, search by name/username/email)
Invite a user to the team by email
Update a team member (role, confirm join request)
List access groups for a team, project or member
List members of an access group

webhooks_user_events.notes: The webhooks event list covers deployments, domains, projects, integrations and flags; no team-member events seen.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs are Enterprise-only and exported as CSV from the dashboard or streamed to a SIEM (paid Enterprise extra, moving to Audit Log Drains). No audit-log REST endpoint seen in the API reference.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Schema Discovery and Entitlement Management.

entra.notes: Entra is a supported SAML provider; no Entra gallery tutorial found at learn.microsoft.com (vercel-tutorial returned 404).

google.notes: Vercel names Google Directory as a Directory Sync source and Google as a SAML provider; no Google catalogue page checked.
